name: Stocking Jetsteam
summary: Stocking Jetsteam is an Alliance quest offered by Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh. Preparing his siege engine for an extended deployment with the Ironforge Siege Brigade, the pilot enlists local hunters to gather boar meat and bear pelts to provision his crew.

sections.title: Provisioning the Engine
sections.body: Stationed just outside Kharanos at Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Bellowfiz oversees preparations for an upcoming long-haul operation on behalf of the Siege Brigade. His siege tank, dubbed Jetsteam, requires both mechanical tuning from master engineer Beldin Steelgrill and a month's worth of field provisions to keep its crew functional in the harsh sub-zero temperatures of Dun Morogh.

sections.title: Hunting the Snow Fields
sections.body: Because Beldin Steelgrill is occupied under Jetsteam's hood, Bellowfiz cannot abandon his vehicle to gather rations and insulation. He directs travelers to hunt in the snowy plains south of the Grizzled Den, where indigenous boars provide hardy meat for food and native bears yield thick pelts suitable for warm tank bedding.

faq.answer: Jetsteam is the siege tank operated by the dwarf Pilot Bellowfiz. Stationed at Steelgrill's Depot, it is being tuned and provisioned for an extended military deployment on behalf of the Ironforge Siege Brigade.

Pilot Bellowfiz, nicknamed Fizzer, is a dwarven siege engine pilot of the Ironforge Siege Brigade. While his vehicle undergoes mechanical adjustments at Steelgrill's Depot, he coordinates field supplies for his upcoming mission.

faq.q: Where can the required supplies be gathered?
faq.answer: Pilot Bellowfiz points hunters toward the snowy flats south of the Grizzled Den, an area inhabited by local boars and bears whose meat and pelts provide adequate provisions and bedding.
The Siege Brigade is Ironforge's corps of siege engine pilots, operating heavily armored war machines like Jetsteam and Trollplow in support of dwarven defense and Alliance campaigns.

faq.q: Where does this mission lead next?
faq.answer: After restocking Jetsteam with meat and furs, Pilot Bellowfiz sends travelers west to Brewnall Village in the quest Evershine, seeking a potent brew he uses both to keep warm and as emergency fuel for the tank's furnace.

faq.q: Why does a siege engine require animal furs?
faq.answer: The interior of a dwarven or gnomish steam tank is frigid and drafty during long operations in the mountain snows. Thick bear pelts provide vital warmth and insulation for crew bedding during prolonged stays away from camp.

angles.text: Assisting Bellowfiz keeps the dwarven Siege Brigade, Ironforge's mechanized ally to the exiled gnomes, fully supplied for the long campaigns ahead.
Providing game from Dun Morogh's crags keeps the Siege Brigade's dwarven crews fed and rested while working out of Khaz Modan's machine yards.
Harvesting thick cuts of boar meat in the Dun Morogh drifts highlights the staple game that sustains local mountain garrisons.
Cooperation between dwarven repair yards and the Siege Brigade's armored crews keeps the Alliance's frontline siege technology functional.
